description: This source file implements a class and functions for incremental lookup in a fixed set data structure, specifically a DAFSA (Deterministic Acyclic Finite State Automaton). It includes methods for advancing through the automaton based on input characters, retrieving result codes, and performing string lookups within the automaton.

classes.name: FixedSetIncrementalLookup
classes.description: A class for performing incremental lookups in a fixed set represented as a DAFSA, supporting advancing with input characters and retrieving associated result codes.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the lookup state with a new input character, updating internal position pointers.

methods.name: GetResultForCurrentSequence
methods.description: Retrieves the result code associated with the current position in the automaton.
